title: Hand-held depth-camera rig, printed-fastener version
summary: The two-Kinect gimbal rig rebuilt from what is on the shelf: every bolt, nut, axle, dowel and thumbscrew is printed; only the 608 bearings and brass heat-set inserts are bought-in parts already owned.
material: PLA-CF (black frame), orange PLA (gimbal, knobs), grey PLA (printed hardware), TPU (straps, feet)
notes: Own project, a test of building the rig with no purchases. Print the two fit-test plates first (printed 1/4"-20, M8 and M5 threads in three clearances, nut pockets, dowels, screws into the brass inserts, and the 1/4"-20 screws in the Kinect itself). The bearing pockets and insert holes come from the first fit test, which was stopped at layer 58/197 and is not yet test-fitted (its pockets and holes are formed). Joints: one M8 rod through both pitch bearings and the wedge clamps the cheeks (6 dowels locate them); the roll axle works in tension and the two spare 608s are thrust rollers under the hub face, so the payload never bends it; the skid rod screws into a printed thread in the right cheek foot with a knurled nut on the left. Hardware and knobs print at 0.12 mm with no supports; frame parts 30 % gyroid, 5 walls, 0.16 mm. Plates: Fit test A: printed threads + pockets (black): 1.9 h, 41 g; Fit test B: printed screws, nuts, pins (grey): 2.1 h, 20 g; Black 1: cheeks + spacers: 4.7 h, 116 g; Black 2: handle arms: 5.6 h, 134 g; Black 3: hub, wedge, grips: 14.4 h, 354 g; Orange: gimbal, skid, phone mount, posts: 8.3 h, 220 g; Orange knobs + cable posts (lying, reprint): collar nuts, thumbscrews (0.12 mm): 3.4 h, 39 g; Grey hardware: rods, bolts, nuts, dowels, screws (0.12 mm): 4.5 h, 55 g; TPU: straps + feet: 0.6 h, 5 g. Rig without fit tests 41.5 h, 924 g. Tools: 4, 5, 6 mm hex keys. Cut the 0.32 mm membrane in the rear bearing seat of the hub before assembly. Black 3 runs over 14 h: reboot Gås first. The cable posts print lying since 2026-11-25 (standing, their flared tips strung up at the end of the orange plate); they are reprinted on the orange knobs plate. Checked against 20 automatic targets, 18 pass; open: P1 kinect_lower WFOV @pitch-45/roll15: 8843 mm3 (grip_l, f_grip_bolt_0); E6 total 2118 g in hand (Kinects 880, phone 200, printed+hardware 1038), gimbal payload 1198 g.
